title: Number of Registered .MY Domains with IPv6 DNS
description: Number of .MY domains with IPv6 DNS registered with MYNIC Berhad.

fields.name: series
fields.title: Series Type
fields.description: [String] Either cumulative ('cumulative') or net new registrations ('new_net'). Note that net new registrations is the sum of new domain registrations minus domain deletions.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] Date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with DD set to 01 as this is monthly data.

fields.name: domain
fields.title: Domain Category
fields.description: [String] The category of .MY domain (such as .com.my, .edu.my, etc.), or total ('overall').

methodology:
MYNIC Berhad is the sole official .MY domain registry recognised by the ICANN (Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers). As such, MYNIC stores transactional records on all .MY domain registrations. As a complement to the [main dataset](https://data.gov.my/data-catalogue/domains) showing the total number of active .MY domains, this dataset tracks the number of domains which are configured to use an IPv6 DNS (Internal Protocol version 6) DNS, versus the IPv4 which was the first publicly used version of the Internet Protocol. Tracking this statistic helps measure the adoption of modern, future-proof internet technologies in Malaysia.

The data is disaggregated into the following domain categories:
- **.my** : For all individuals, companies and organisations from any country
- **.com.my** : For commercial organisations/activities
- **.biz.my** : For commercial organisations/activities and MSMEs
- **.net.my** : For network-related organisations/activities
- **.org.my** : For other organisations/activitie registered under the Registrar of Societies
- **.edu.my** : For registered Malaysian educational institutions/organisations
- **.gov.my** : For official Malaysian government agencies/organisations
- **.mil.my** : For official Malaysian military agencies/organisations
- **.name.my** : For the personal use of Malaysian citizens
- **.coop.my** : For Malaysian cooperatives registered under the Cooperative Commission of Malaysia
publication: This data is fully consistent with the data published on [MYNIC's official statistics page](https://mynic.my/media/statistics).
